בְּקוֹל צֶרַח שׁוֹפָר: עֲוֹנוֹת מוֹחֶה. עַבְדוּת מְאַחֶה. עֲבוֹדוֹת מַנְחֶה. קוֹל חִצּוּר שׁוֹפָר: פַּגֵּר וְהַסְעִיר. מַמְלְכוּת שָׂעִיר. פִּשְׁעָהּ תָּעִיר. בְּקוֹל קוֹלוֹת שׁוֹפָר: פִּתְחֵי הָעִיר. תַּשְׁקִיעַ וְתַבְעִיר. פַּחַד רַב וְצָעִיר. מִקּוֹל הֶמְיַת שׁוֹפָר: צִיּוּן רֶמֶז אוֹת. שׁוֹפָרוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת. צְוָחָה בְּמִדְיָן דְּאוֹת. בְּקוֹל שִׁתּוּף שׁוֹפָר: צִפְצְפוּ צְבָאוֹת. כְּשָׁרוּ פְּלָאוֹת. צוּר כְּעַשׂ נִפְלָאוֹת. בְּקוֹל עָרֵב שׁוֹפָר: קוֹל חֲלוּשָׁה. בְּאַרְקָא חֲלָשָׁה. קֹלוֹת מַתַּן שְׁלֹשָׁה. קוֹלוֹת כְּנִתְּנוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר: קֶרֶן מְשֻׁלָּשָׁה. הַיּוֹם לְזֵכֶר אֲשַׁלְּשָׁה. קְרוֹא עוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה. בְּקוֹל עָתוּד שׁוֹפָר: רָחַשְׁתִּי לַעֲלִית.

blocks.text: Shofar. Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar. Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar. Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar. Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar. Israel’s hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar. A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar. A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar. I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.

blocks.text: As it is written through Thy prophet: ‘And on that day the great Shofar will be blown and the wanderers in the land of Assyria and the banished in the land of Egypt shall come and prostrate themselves to the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem’.

Fasten Thy laws to me lest they fly away like the eagle, lest there take flight those who make heard Thy voice. I will learn the pure law with my eyes on my Teacher just as once His messenger (Moses) spoke and God answered him with His voice.
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’.

The end has approached, the time of judgment comes, a defender arises to entreat with his voice. The new moon is sanctified and the feast prepared, so let me blow the Shofar that He may answer me with His voice.
As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob’.
